what: a box of six trimmed planes where the edge (0,0,0)-(0,20,0) stops 0.01 mm short of its end corner in both faces that use it: the small gap must be closed, giving a closed box instead of two dropped faces
method: box 10 x 20 x 30 of six trimmed bilinear patches: V = 6000; A = 2(200+300+600) = 2200; 6 faces (the 0.01 mm gap changes nothing within tolerance)
